subject: Next steps: MediaMint POC — prompt/log intake & eval gating
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Zhao <ellen.zhao@mediamint.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-09-14T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + next steps (prompt/log intake)

Hi Ellen — great to meet you and the MediaMint team on the call. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment for the POC: 

Summary of the call:
- Goal: Validate that Redwood inference reduces per-query latency and cost while maintaining answer quality for MediaMint's creative prompt suite (ad copy and headline variants).
- Success criteria (customer-defined): mean latency < 150ms 95th pct under production-like burst; average relevance scoring >= 0.85 on your evaluation rubric; 30% cost reduction vs current baseline on similar throughput.

Immediate asks from MediaMint:
1) Provide a representative prompt/log sample (<= 5k rows) with original user prompt, context metadata, and ground truth/outcome where available. PII should be redacted unless we agree a secure transfer.
2) Identify the evaluation metric(s) you want us to run (e.g., relevance, click-prediction calibration, A/B uplift proxy).
3) Share any operational constraints (rate limits, hard latency SLOs, geo restrictions).

Proposed Redwood deliverables & timeline:
- Redwood will run an initial evaluation on a 2k-row sample and deliver a concise scorecard within 5 business days after we receive the sample.
- Week 1: Ingest and sanity-check prompts; agree on eval rubric and gating thresholds.
- Week 2: Full 1–2 week POC run with optimized serving config (batching/quantization suggestions) and a final report.

Ownership (suggested):
- MediaMint provides prompt/log bundle + rubric: Ellen / Data Team
- Redwood runs eval and config recommendations: Rishi + Priyom (SE)
- CS/production handoff: Marissa

Secure transfer options we can accept: short-lived S3 presigned URL, secure SharePoint, or our tokenized upload link (we can create one for the trial).

Attaching a short intake checklist and scope workbook stub for you to fill (see attachments).

Can you confirm you can share the sample by end of EOD Friday (2028-09-15) and whether the data includes any PII that needs special handling?

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142
From: Ellen Zhao <ellen.zhao@mediamint.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: MediaMint Data Team <data@mediamint.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-09-15T09:13:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps (prompt/log intake)

Thanks Rishi — appreciate the clear summary. Quick answers: 

- We can produce a 3k-row CSV extract of prompts + metadata by Friday EOD. The file will include: prompt_text, user_intent_tag, campaign_id, timestamp, and the outcome_label (whether the creative drove a click in the landing page; binary).
- No obvious PII in the fields we plan to export; the only potentially sensitive column is user_id — we can hash that before sending.
- Eval metrics we'd like to prioritize: relevance precision@5 (human-annotated), and a proxy uplift metric based on click-through correlation. We can share a short rubric this afternoon.

For secure transfer, please send the Redwood upload link — we'd prefer that to S3 presigned URLs. Also attaching a tiny sample (10 rows) inline for quick sanity check.

Ellen
Ellen Zhao
Head of Data Science, MediaMint
ellen.zhao@mediamint.ai

Attachment: media_prompt_sample_20280914.csv (10-row sample stub)
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Zhao <ellen.zhao@mediamint.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-09-16T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Post-call recap + next steps (prompt/log intake) — formatting & transfer details

Thanks Ellen — looks good. A few technical notes for the sample we need to ensure our eval run is reproducible: 

1) File format: CSV UTF-8 or newline-delimited JSON (ndjson). Prefer ndjson for large sets, but CSV is fine for 3k rows.
2) Required columns: id, prompt_text, context (optional), outcome_label (optional), timestamp. If user_id is present, please SHA256-hash it and note the salt (if any).
3) Labeling: If you have a human-annotated relevance column, name it "relevance_label" with values 0/1/2 (0=irrelevant, 1=okay, 2=highly relevant). If not, we can run an automated scoring and then have annotators spot-check.
4) File transfer: we'll create a tokenized upload link that expires in 7 days. We'll also provide an S3 presigned URL if your infra team prefers.

Next steps for us once we receive the bundle: 
- Ingest + schema validation (1 business day)
- Run sanity-generation checks to ensure prompts are well-formed (1 business day)
- Baseline run + simple reranking experiment (3 business days)

I will generate the upload token and one-line instructions this afternoon. Also copying Marissa for commercial/POC logistics.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai

Related attachments referenced: mediamint_poc_scope.xlsx (scope workbook), prompt-intake-checklist.md (internal)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Zhao <ellen.zhao@mediamint.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-09-18T10:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps (prompt/log intake) — upload link and timeline

Ellen — thanks for the quick turnaround. Upload link (tokenized) created: https://redwood.app/s/transfer/MM-2028-042?token=eyJhbCI... (expires 2028-09-25).

Checklist before upload:
- Hash user_id (if present), or remove it.
- Include a short README.txt describing the columns and any label definitions.
- Attach the rubric you mentioned (relevance criteria) so we can map our scoring.

Committed timeline after we get the full bundle:
- T+1 business day: schema & sanity checks (Priyom)
- T+3 business days: initial 2k sample evaluation and scorecard (Rishi + Priyom)
- T+10 business days: final POC report with config recommendations and cost/latency tradeoffs (Marissa will coordinate the executive summary).

If you confirm upload by EOD Friday we can meet the T+3 deliverable on the following Wednesday. Any blockers we should be aware of?

Thanks — excited to run this.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
